accepted_scope_and_limitations.accepted_scope: Bounded local M1 Windows 11 x64 evaluation foundation (read-only 3-record handbook, deterministic route/relevance gating, shadow-only 4,163-parameter MLP, exclusive-lease fault-tolerant journal/quarantine, portable ZIP packaging).
limitations: Clean disconnected Windows machine with no installed .NET 10.0.12 desktop runtime not tested (workstation has .NET 10.0.12 installed globally, though private runtime path loading was confirmed).
Packages and PowerShell scripts are unsigned (Windows PowerShell default Restricted policy requires process-local -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned).
Hyper-V guest preflight (tools/check-guest.ps1) denied Get-VM authorization; computer automation remains disabled/unavailable.
Original native model remains shadow-only (54/72 on public synthetic templates, tied with linear comparator; no independent evaluator custody or empirical task-outcome labels yet).

Relevance.Supports uses per-revision regular-expression grammars and conservatively abstains ('needs clarification') on unfamiliar valid phrasings (e.g. 'Please state the archive retention duration.', 'How are archives restored?', 'How many days are exports retained?').
